verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.60 relative to the control trajectory in the 12 months after 13 Feb 2020 (90% interval −0.71 to −0.50). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). The control trajectory tracked the area less closely than usual before the event (pre-event error 0.06 vs typical 0.01); the fit check passed only because the change is more than 4 times that error.
